newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ausdoc says Brambles bid unacceptable.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ausdoc says Brambles bid unacceptable.

text.p: Ausdoc Group Ltd said on Tuesday it regarded the takeover bid by diversified transport company Brambles Industries Ltd as unacceptable and advised shareholders to take no action at the moment.

"Based an the Directors' current perception of the strategic positioning and operational performance of the Company, the Directors of AUSDOC consider the proposed offer to be unacceptable," the company said in a statement.

"Shareholders are advised to take no action in relation to Brambles, proposed conditional takeover offer until AUSDOC's Directors have issued their formal Part B response and recommendations regarding the proposed offer."
Brambles announced its A$2.00 per share cash bid on Monday, saying the A$111 million offer for the document exchange group was 40 percent above the average six-month price.
